name: Example organization storage rules
description: Metadata-only examples. These rules cannot execute cleanup.

rules.title: Old partial browser download
rules.why_it_exists: Browsers and download clients use temporary extensions for incomplete transfers.
rules.recommendation: Confirm the transfer is inactive and no resumable download is needed.

rules.title: Rebuildable organization web cache
rules.why_it_exists: Web tooling retains transformed assets and incremental-build state.
rules.recommendation: Confirm the owning project is reproducible and inactive; use its supported cache workflow after approval.
rules.removal_risk: The next build can be slow and locally generated state can be lost.

rules.title: Forensic case evidence store
rules.why_it_exists: The path naming indicates case/evidence retention rather than disposable cache data.
rules.recommendation: Preserve and follow organizational evidence-retention and chain-of-custody procedures.
rules.removal_risk: Unique evidence and chain of custody can be destroyed.
